Where the condos are and what to know

items.t: Working boundary only (no official boundary is published): the farm land and East Ladner urban edge east of the Ladner village core, around Ladner Trunk Road, 60B Street and Highway 17A, based on references to the former East Ladner Area Plan and application addresses in City council reports.

Main roads: Highway 17A, Ladner Trunk Road and Highway 99 through the George Massey Tunnel, with Highway 17 (South Fraser Perimeter Road) to the south; TransLink route 601 runs via Ladner Exchange, Ladner Trunk Road, Highway 17A and Highway 99, and route 620 runs via Ladner Exchange, Highway 17A and Highway 17.
Fraser Health describes East Delta only as farmland in Delta, noting the Good Samaritan Delta View Care Centre is located in the farmlands of East Delta.
Nearby areas: Ladner village and the Ladner sub-areas (Hawthorne, Holly, Neilsen Grove, Port Guichon) to the west; North Delta across the farm belt to the northeast; Tsawwassen to the southwest.

Where the condo stock actually concentrates: it does not. The only strata growth on the urban edge is townhouse product on 60B Street. Schools are address-based in SD37 (K–7 elementary, 8–12 secondary, no middle tier).
Services are in Ladner: Ladner Pioneer Library, 4683 51 Street, and Delta Hospital, 5800 Mountain View Blvd, next to Ladner Exchange.

There are no East Delta market figures to quote — from any legitimate source. SnapStats covers only 14 communities and its Delta coverage is North Delta only; South Delta (Ladner / Tsawwassen / East Delta) is not covered, and North Delta numbers must never be presented as East Delta numbers.
The Boundary Bay Dyke Trail runs on the south side of the farm area, from 17A Avenue to Mud Bay in Boundary Bay Regional Park (Metro Vancouver).

Streamside rules reach farm ditches. The City requires checks for flood protection requirements, the Riparian Areas Regulation and streamside rules before development near regulated water bodies — and all Delta properties within 30 m of a stream, including sloughs and ditches, fall within the Streamside Protection and Enhancement Development Permit Area.

blocks.text: Where the townhomes are and what to know

items.t: Schools: catchments are address-based in SD37 (elementary K–7, secondary 8–12, no middle-school tier), checked in the SD37 School Locator.

Services are in Ladner, not in East Delta itself: Ladner Pioneer Library, 4683 51 Street (Fraser Valley Regional Library), serves the area, and Delta Hospital, 5800 Mountain View Blvd, is Fraser Health's community hospital for Delta, next to Ladner Exchange.
The Boundary Bay Dyke Trail runs from 17A Avenue to Mud Bay in Boundary Bay Regional Park (Metro Vancouver), on the south side of the Delta farm area.

Market context: none stated. SnapStats covers North Delta, but East Delta sits on the Ladner/South Delta side and the SnapStats FVR September 2026 report contains no East Delta sub-area row and no Ladner/South Delta community section — North Delta numbers must never be presented as East Delta numbers, and none is presented here.

A2 (s. 10.20.6) also sets an 8 ha subdivision minimum; A3 (s. 10.30.6) does not permit subdivision.

blocks.text: Lots and land in East Delta

items.t: Most East Delta land is farm or rural freehold rather than strata, mainly under A1 Agriculture zoning (one farm house per lot). Existing farm parcels vary in size and are confirmed parcel by parcel.
Subdivision math that governs any new lot: in the A1 zone (s. A2 (s. 10.20.6) likewise sets an 8 ha minimum lot area created by subdivision; A3 (s. 10.30.6) does not permit subdivision.

Residential footprint on a farm parcel (A1 zone): one farm house per lot, farm house maximum 500 m², farm home plate maximum 3,600 m², one secondary suite inside the farm house, and one accessory farm dwelling unit of maximum 90 m² on lots of 40 ha or less or 186 m² on lots over 40 ha.

Urban edge: East Ladner parcels take the RS and RD zones in the Ladner ladder, assigned parcel by parcel on the City's zoning maps — the zone on a specific edge parcel is a City-map read, not a sub-area assumption.

Servicing: farm properties not connected to a community sewer use onsite sewage systems — Fraser Health requires a building with indoor plumbing that is not connected to a community sewer to use an onsite system complying with the Sewerage System Regulation, designed and installed by an Authorized Person; a property's well is searched in the provincial GWELLS registry, noting wells built before the Water Sustainability Act came into force may not be in the registry.
Skye at Holly Park, 4760 60B Street.
Where bare-land strata exists elsewhere it is strata tenure (Form B / fees / bylaws apply) — stated as the general form only.
The farm belt is ALR ground designated "Agriculture (A)" in the current OCP; the urban East Ladner edge is non-ALR urban land under the same consolidated plan.

blocks.text: Where lots come up and what to know

items.t: Market context: none stated. Delta is not covered by SnapStats for South Delta — its Delta coverage is North Delta only, the FVR September 2026 report contains no East Delta row and no Ladner / South Delta section, and North Delta numbers must never be presented as East Delta numbers. Land has no SnapStats category anywhere.

The name itself is the first trap: "East Delta" sounds like a North Delta counterpart, but the ground is Ladner's farm belt — pricing, statistics and services all run through Ladner / South Delta, and North Delta numbers must never be presented as East Delta numbers.

Check the home plate, not just the house: the A1 farm home plate maximum is 3,600 m², capping the residential footprint including the farm house and accessory buildings — a buyer planning a large house-plus-barn footprint hits this before the 500 m² house cap.

Streamside rules reach farm ditches: a farm lot's ditch can put part of the parcel inside the 30 m Streamside Protection and Enhancement Development Permit Area, limiting building and subdivision work there.

faq.a: Under ALC rules, one principal residence plus, in some cases, one additional detached residence up to 90 m² (40 ha or less) or 186 m² (over 40 ha); Delta's A1 zone allows one accessory farm dwelling unit within those same limits.
faq.q: Can a farm parcel here have a second dwelling?

faq.a: 8 ha in the A1 zone, subject to OCP compliance and Agricultural Land Commission Act approval where applicable (Zoning Bylaw No. 7600, s. 10.10.8).
faq.q: What is the smallest new farm lot that can be created?

faq.a: ALC Information Bulletin 09, s. 6, treats strata plans as plans that cause subdivision in the ALR, so stratification is not an ordinary route for ALR residences.
faq.q: Why can't ALR residences just be stratified into condos?

faq.a: Price and compare any property as what it legally is: an ALR farm parcel or an urban East Ladner lot under the consolidated OCP, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024).
faq.q: Is East Delta a real neighbourhood I can search by?

faq.a: Subdivision in A1 needs a minimum 8 ha new lot, OCP compliance and ALC Act approval where applicable; and an ALR residence cannot be stratified at all.
faq.q: Can I stratify or subdivide a farm parcel here?

faq.a: In some cases: one principal residence (capped at 500 m² without an ALC application) plus one additional detached residence up to 90 m² on parcels of 40 ha or less or 186 m² on larger parcels; Delta's A1 zone also allows one accessory farm dwelling unit within those size limits.
faq.q: Can a farm parcel have a second dwelling?

faq.a: Only within the A-zone / ALR frame: a new A1 lot created by subdivision needs a minimum of 8 ha, OCP compliance and Agricultural Land Commission Act approval where applicable (home site severance excepted under ALC policy); A2 likewise needs 8 ha; A3 does not permit subdivision at all.
faq.q: Can I subdivide a farm parcel here?

faq.a: Often not — unconnected buildings use onsite sewage systems under the Sewerage System Regulation (Authorized Person design/install), and wells are searched in GWELLS, with pre-Water Sustainability Act wells possibly unrecorded. Confirm per parcel.
faq.q: Is a farm parcel on city water and sewer?

faq.a: Yes — the City requires flood-protection and streamside checks before development near regulated water bodies, any lot within 30 m of a stream, slough or ditch is in the Streamside Protection DPA, and Boundary Bay dike sections between 72 Street and 88 Street are being raised.
faq.q: Is flood risk a diligence item on the farm belt?

faq.a: Only within the ALC caps: One additional detached residence up to 90 m² on parcels of 40 ha or less, or 186 m² on larger parcels; beyond that needs ALC approval.
